data:
usage: lpst [-h] {record,synthesize,playback,rerecord} ...

CLI recorder for lazy tests

positional arguments:
  {record,synthesize,playback,rerecord}
    record              Record a test
    synthesize          Manually write a transcript
    playback            Playback tests
    rerecord            Playback tests and edit failures

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
